name: How do I choose the right bathroom layout for a primary suite?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right bathroom layout for a primary suite remodel?
mainEntity.text: How do I choose the right bathroom layout for a primary suite remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary suite bathrooms should feel more relaxed and more functional than a basic hall bath. The layout should support privacy, generous storage, and comfortable movement from the bedroom into the bath. In many luxury remodels, this means giving the shower more presence, selecting a vanity that fits the room without dominating it, and adding thoughtful storage for daily routines. Lighting and window placement also matter because they shape how premium the room feels. The best primary-suite layouts avoid awkward compromises and instead create a sequence of spaces that feels intentional. If the room allows, separating the shower, tub, toilet, and vanity zones can make the bathroom feel far more refined.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary suite layout should prioritize privacy, a larger shower or tub zone, enough storage, and a clear path between the bedroom and bathroom. The best layout makes the room feel calm, spacious, and easy to use every day.
